fixes.explanation: Judges is a fair guess after all that fire, baker. But Moses turns to the LORD and says, "Surely You love the people…" (Deuteronomy 33:3). Flaming fire and myriads of holy ones in verse 2, and I'd be hiding behind my oven. Moses talks about love.

This one is true, baker. Moses says of Levi, "He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel…" (Deuteronomy 33:10). That's a teaching job for the whole people. I can barely keep one batch of dough in line.

Perez and Zerah are sons of Judah (Genesis 46:12), and Judah's blessing is back in verse 7. Joseph's blessing closes with "Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh." (Deuteronomy 33:17). Those are Joseph's two sons (Genesis 41:51-52). Good names, wrong blessing, friend.

Gershon and Kohath are sons of Levi (Genesis 46:11), so they belong back with Levi's blessing in verses 8 to 11. Joseph's blessing closes with "Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh." (Deuteronomy 33:17). Those are Joseph's two sons (Genesis 41:51-52). Good names, just the wrong blessing, friend.
